title:
We are Modern Partners 365.
Senior Microsoft delivery, minus the friction.
subtitle: Modern Partners 365 (MP365) is an independent Microsoft solutions consulting partner. For over 20 years, we have helped mid-market and enterprise organizations execute complex tenant migrations, Dynamics 365 implementations, and cloud governance — led directly by principal architects, with zero consulting bureaucracy.

whoWeAre.title: An engineering-first Microsoft partner built for high-stakes enterprise delivery
whoWeAre.lead: Modern Partners 365 was founded on a simple premise: enterprise organizations deserve direct access to the specialists who actually configure the tenant, write the code, and run the cutover.
story: Traditional systems integrators pitch with senior executives and staff engagements with rotating junior analysts learning on the client's invoice. At Modern Partners 365, we deliberately dismantled that model. Every client works directly with seasoned platform architects who bring two decades of hands-on technical discipline.

We partner with mid-market and enterprise organizations across North America facing high-stakes Microsoft challenges. Our engagements concentrate on the technical domains where precision is paramount: tenant-to-tenant M&A cutovers under strict regulatory and TSA deadlines, enterprise Dynamics 365 and Power Platform modernization, and Microsoft Purview data governance.
whoWeAre.quote: “We measure our success not by billable hours or headcount, but by whether your teams can log in and work seamlessly on Day 1.”

pillars.title: Principal-Led Architecture
pillars.desc: No junior staffing and no account management layers. The architects who scope your technical roadmap are the ones who execute it.

pillars.title: Engineering Over Bureaucracy
pillars.desc: We replace multi-month generic discovery cycles with rapid architectural audits, proven automation tooling, and fixed-scope certainty.

pillars.title: Tested Day-1 Predictability
pillars.desc: Every cutover, migration, and deployment is engineered backward from operational deadlines, with validated coexistence and tested rollback plans.

cards.title: Direct access to senior architects

cards.highlight: Day-1 coexistence first, zero business disruption
